summary.intent: Run Phase 39 executor and Phase 38 simplify/review agents in parallel, with the Phase 39 agent isolated in its own worktree to avoid working tree conflicts.
summary.outcome: Phase 39 executor was relaunched in an isolated worktree, and three simplify/review agents (reuse, quality, efficiency) were launched against the Phase 38 branch in parallel. vault-settings.service.ts was modified as part of this work.

repo: Phase-based development workflow: each phase has its own branch (e.g., docs/phase-38-context) and agents run simplify/review passes after implementation.
Phase 39 executor agents must run in an isolated worktree to avoid conflicts with the main working tree.

code.finding: Modified during Phase 38 simplify pass — likely refactored for reuse, quality, or efficiency improvements.

workflow: Executor agents for a new phase should always be launched in a worktree (isolation: 'worktree') so they don't block or conflict with the main thread's working directory.
Simplify/review agents should target the correct feature branch, not whatever branch happens to be checked out in the main thread.
Feedback about incorrect branch/worktree usage was saved to persistent memory immediately to prevent recurrence.

friction: Phase 39 executor was initially started on the wrong branch (main thread) instead of an isolated worktree — required restarting the work.
Simplify agents were initially targeting the wrong branch, requiring a stash and branch switch before relaunching.
open_items: Verify Phase 39 executor worktree completed successfully and its changes are ready to merge.
Confirm all three Phase 38 simplify agents (reuse, quality, efficiency) completed and their findings were applied.
